attributes.message: We are experiencing slowness on large file downloads in Asia region since 7AM UTC. This only affects downloads via the huggingface CLI. Root cause identified and mitigation in progress.
Issue is solved, Asia traffic back to nominal bandwidth performances.

attributes.title: Data serving slowness in Asia region

attributes.message: Between 07:58 and 08:05 UTC, the AWS CDN returned an elevated rate of HTTP 500 errors for a portion of requests in the Asia-Pacific (Singapore / ap-southeast-1) region. The cause was a transient internal service disruption, which has been mitigated.
Resolved. Error rates returned to normal at 08:05 UTC and the CDN is operating normally. The disruption lasted approximately 7 minutes. We apologize for any inconvenience.

During a short window inside this period (roughly 5–10 minutes) write operations may briefly return a 503 ("temporarily unavailable due to maintenance") while we complete upgrades to infrastructure. Reads and already-running jobs are not affected, and no action is needed on your end.

Services are back to nominal operations.

Root cause confirmed to global Amazon Web Services outage.
Hugging Face platform is unavailable from most regions in the world due following a global outage from Amazon Web Services. We are working on a mitigation.
We are mitigating the issue, and services are coming back up.

During a short window inside this period (roughly 5–10 minutes) endpoint management operations (creating, updating, pausing, or resuming endpoints) may briefly return a 503 ("temporarily unavailable due to maintenance") while we complete upgrades to infrastructure. Running endpoints and inference requests are not affected, and no action is needed on your end.
